verses.original: אָ֣ז יָשִֽׁיר־ מֹשֶׁה֩ וּבְנֵ֨י יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל אֶת־ הַשִּׁירָ֤ה הַזֹּאת֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה וַיֹּאמְר֖וּ לֵאמֹ֑ר אָשִׁ֤ירָה לַֽיהוָה֙ כִּֽי־ גָאֹ֣ה גָּאָ֔ה ס֥וּס וְרֹכְב֖וֹ רָמָ֥ה בַיָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’āz yā·šîr- mō·šeh ū·ḇə·nê yiś·rā·’êl ’eṯ- haš·šî·rāh haz·zōṯ Yah·weh way·yō·mə·rū lê·mōr ’ā·šî·rāh Yah·weh kî- ḡā·’ōh gā·’āh sūs wə·rō·ḵə·ḇōw rā·māh ḇay·yām
verses.literal: Then Moses and the Israelites . . . sang this song to the LORD - I will sing to the LORD for He is highly exalted . . . The horse and rider He has thrown into the sea
verses.literalPt: ENTÃO cantou Moisés e os filhos de Israel este cântico ao SENHOR, e falaram, dizendo: Cantarei ao SENHOR, porque gloriosamente triunfou; lançou no mar o cavalo e o seu cavaleiro.

verses.original: עָזִּ֤י וְזִמְרָת֙ יָ֔הּ וַֽיְהִי־ לִ֖י לִֽישׁוּעָ֑ה זֶ֤ה אֵלִי֙ וְאַנְוֵ֔הוּ אֱלֹהֵ֥י אָבִ֖י וַאֲרֹמְמֶֽנְהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ‘āz·zî wə·zim·rāṯ yāh way·hî- lî lî·šū·‘āh zeh ’ê·lî wə·’an·wê·hū ’ĕ·lō·hê ’ā·ḇî wa·’ă·rō·mə·men·hū
verses.literal: The LORD is my strength and my song and He has become my salvation He is my God and I will praise Him my father’s God and I will exalt Him
verses.literalPt: O SENHOR é a minha força, e o meu cântico; ele me foi por salvação; este é o meu Deus, portanto lhe farei uma habitação; ele é o Deus de meu pai, por isso o exaltarei.

verses.original: יְהוָ֖ה אִ֣ישׁ מִלְחָמָ֑ה יְהוָ֖ה שְׁמֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ’îš mil·ḥā·māh Yah·weh šə·mōw
verses.literal: The LORD is a warrior . . . the LORD is His name
verses.literalPt: O SENHOR é homem de guerra; o SENHOR é o seu nome.

verses.original: מַרְכְּבֹ֥ת פַּרְעֹ֛ה וְחֵיל֖וֹ יָרָ֣ה בַיָּ֑ם וּמִבְחַ֥ר שָֽׁלִשָׁ֖יו טֻבְּע֥וּ בְיַם־ סֽוּף׃
verses.transliteration: mar·kə·ḇōṯ par·‘ōh wə·ḥê·lōw yā·rāh ḇay·yām ū·miḇ·ḥar šā·li·šāw ṭub·bə·‘ū ḇə·yam- sūp̄
verses.literal: Pharaoh’s chariots and army He has cast into the sea the finest of his officers are drowned in the Red Sea
verses.literalPt: Lançou no mar os carros de Faraó e o seu exército; e os seus escolhidos príncipes afogaram-se no Mar Vermelho.

verses.original: תְּהֹמֹ֖ת יְכַסְיֻ֑מוּ יָרְד֥וּ בִמְצוֹלֹ֖ת כְּמוֹ־ אָֽבֶן׃
verses.transliteration: tə·hō·mōṯ yə·ḵas·yu·mū yā·rə·ḏū ḇim·ṣō·w·lōṯ kə·mōw- ’ā·ḇen
verses.literal: The depths have covered them they sank there like a stone
verses.literalPt: Os abismos os cobriram; desceram às profundezas como pedra.

verses.original: יְמִֽינְךָ֣ יְהוָ֔ה נֶאְדָּרִ֖י בַּכֹּ֑חַ יְמִֽינְךָ֥ יְהוָ֖ה תִּרְעַ֥ץ אוֹיֵֽב׃
verses.transliteration: yə·mî·nə·ḵā Yah·weh ne’·dā·rî bak·kō·aḥ yə·mî·nə·ḵā Yah·weh tir·‘aṣ ’ō·w·yêḇ
verses.literal: Your right hand O LORD is majestic in power Your right hand O LORD has shattered the enemy
verses.literalPt: A tua destra, ó SENHOR, se tem glorificado em poder, a tua destra, ó SENHOR, tem despedaçado o inimigo;

verses.original: וּבְרֹ֥ב גְּאוֹנְךָ֖ תַּהֲרֹ֣ס קָמֶ֑יךָ תְּשַׁלַּח֙ חֲרֹ֣נְךָ֔ יֹאכְלֵ֖מוֹ כַּקַּֽשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·rōḇ gə·’ō·wn·ḵā ta·hă·rōs qā·me·ḵā tə·šal·laḥ ḥă·rō·nə·ḵā yō·ḵə·lê·mōw kaq·qaš
verses.literal: You overthrew Your adversaries by Your great majesty You unleashed Your burning wrath it consumed them like stubble
verses.literalPt: E com a grandeza da tua excelência derrubaste aos que se levantaram contra ti; enviaste o teu furor, que os consumiu como o restolho.

verses.original: וּבְר֤וּחַ אַפֶּ֙יךָ֙ נֶ֣עֶרְמוּ מַ֔יִם נִצְּב֥וּ כְמוֹ־ נֵ֖ד נֹזְלִ֑ים קָֽפְא֥וּ תְהֹמֹ֖ת בְּלֶב־ יָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·rū·aḥ ’ap·pe·ḵā ne·‘er·mū ma·yim niṣ·ṣə·ḇū ḵə·mōw- nêḏ nō·zə·lîm qā·p̄ə·’ū ṯə·hō·mōṯ bə·leḇ- yām
verses.literal: At the blast of Your nostrils the waters piled up like a wall the currents stood firm the depths congealed in the heart of the sea
verses.literalPt: E com o sopro de tuas narinas amontoaram-se as águas, as correntes pararam como montão; os abismos coalharam-se no coração do mar.

verses.original: אָמַ֥ר אוֹיֵ֛ב אֶרְדֹּ֥ף אַשִּׂ֖יג אֲחַלֵּ֣ק שָׁלָ֑ל תִּמְלָאֵ֣מוֹ נַפְשִׁ֔י אָרִ֣יק חַרְבִּ֔י תּוֹרִישֵׁ֖מוֹ יָדִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·mar ’ō·w·yêḇ ’er·dōp̄ ’aś·śîḡ ’ă·ḥal·lêq šā·lāl tim·lā·’ê·mōw nap̄·šî ’ā·rîq ḥar·bî tō·w·rî·šê·mōw yā·ḏî
verses.literal: The enemy declared I will pursue I will overtake I will divide the spoils I will gorge myself on them I will draw my sword my hand will destroy them
verses.literalPt: O inimigo dizia: Perseguirei, alcançarei, repartirei os despojos; fartar-se-á a minha alma deles, arrancarei a minha espada, a minha mão os destruirá.

verses.original: נָשַׁ֥פְתָּ בְרוּחֲךָ֖ כִּסָּ֣מוֹ יָ֑ם צָֽלֲלוּ֙ כַּֽעוֹפֶ֔רֶת בְּמַ֖יִם אַדִּירִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: nā·šap̄·tā ḇə·rū·ḥă·ḵā kis·sā·mōw yām ṣā·lă·lū ka·‘ō·w·p̄e·reṯ bə·ma·yim ’ad·dî·rîm
verses.literal: But You blew with Your breath and the sea covered them They sank like lead in the mighty waters
verses.literalPt: Sopraste com o teu vento, o mar os cobriu; afundaram-se como chumbo em veementes águas.

verses.original: מִֽי־ כָמֹ֤כָה בָּֽאֵלִם֙ יְהוָ֔ה מִ֥י כָּמֹ֖כָה נֶאְדָּ֣ר בַּקֹּ֑דֶשׁ נוֹרָ֥א תְהִלֹּ֖ת עֹ֥שֵׂה פֶֽלֶא׃
verses.transliteration: mî- ḵā·mō·ḵāh bā·’ê·lim Yah·weh mî kā·mō·ḵāh ne’·dār baq·qō·ḏeš nō·w·rā ṯə·hil·lōṯ ‘ō·śêh p̄e·le
verses.literal: Who among the gods is like You O LORD Who is like You majestic in holiness revered with praises performing wonders
verses.literalPt: Ó SENHOR, quem é como tu entre os deuses? Quem é como tu glorificado em santidade, admirável em louvores, realizando maravilhas?

verses.original: נָטִ֙יתָ֙ יְמִ֣ינְךָ֔ תִּבְלָעֵ֖מוֹ אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: nā·ṭî·ṯā yə·mî·nə·ḵā tiḇ·lā·‘ê·mōw ’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: You stretched out Your right hand and the earth swallowed them up
verses.literalPt: Estendeste a tua mão direita; a terra os tragou.

verses.original: נָחִ֥יתָ בְחַסְדְּךָ֖ עַם־ ז֣וּ גָּאָ֑לְתָּ נֵהַ֥לְתָּ בְעָזְּךָ֖ אֶל־ נְוֵ֥ה קָדְשֶֽׁךָ׃
verses.transliteration: nā·ḥî·ṯā ḇə·ḥas·də·ḵā ‘am- zū gā·’ā·lə·tā nê·hal·tā ḇə·‘āz·zə·ḵā ’el- nə·wêh qāḏ·še·ḵā
verses.literal: With loving devotion You will lead the people . . . You have redeemed with Your strength You will guide them to Your holy dwelling
verses.literalPt: Tu, com a tua beneficência, guiaste a este povo, que salvaste; com a tua força o levaste à habitação da tua santidade.

verses.original: שָֽׁמְע֥וּ עַמִּ֖ים יִרְגָּז֑וּן חִ֣יל אָחַ֔ז יֹשְׁבֵ֖י פְּלָֽשֶׁת׃
verses.transliteration: šā·mə·‘ū ‘am·mîm yir·gā·zūn ḥîl ’ā·ḥaz yō·šə·ḇê pə·lā·šeṯ
verses.literal: The nations will hear and tremble anguish will grip the dwellers of Philistia
verses.literalPt: Os povos o ouviram, eles estremeceram, uma dor apoderou-se dos habitantes da Filistia.

verses.original: אָ֤ז נִבְהֲלוּ֙ אַלּוּפֵ֣י אֱד֔וֹם אֵילֵ֣י מוֹאָ֔ב יֹֽאחֲזֵ֖מוֹ רָ֑עַד נָמֹ֕גוּ כֹּ֖ל יֹשְׁבֵ֥י כְנָֽעַן׃
verses.transliteration: ’āz niḇ·hă·lū ’al·lū·p̄ê ’ĕ·ḏō·wm ’ê·lê mō·w·’āḇ yō·ḥă·zê·mōw rā·‘aḏ nā·mō·ḡū kōl yō·šə·ḇê ḵə·nā·‘an
verses.literal: Then the chiefs of Edom will be dismayed trembling will seize the leaders of Moab those who dwell in Canaan will melt away . . .
verses.literalPt: Então os príncipes de Edom se pasmaram; dos poderosos dos moabitas apoderou-se um tremor; derreteram-se todos os habitantes de Canaã.

verses.original: תִּפֹּ֨ל עֲלֵיהֶ֤ם אֵימָ֙תָה֙ וָפַ֔חַד בִּגְדֹ֥ל זְרוֹעֲךָ֖ יִדְּמ֣וּ כָּאָ֑בֶן עַד־ יַעֲבֹ֤ר עַמְּךָ֙ יְהוָ֔ה עַֽד־ יַעֲבֹ֖ר עַם־ ז֥וּ קָנִֽיתָ׃
verses.transliteration: tip·pōl ‘ă·lê·hem ’ê·mā·ṯāh wā·p̄a·ḥaḏ biḡ·ḏōl zə·rō·w·‘ă·ḵā yid·də·mū kā·’ā·ḇen ‘aḏ- ya·‘ă·ḇōr ‘am·mə·ḵā Yah·weh ‘aḏ- ya·‘ă·ḇōr ‘am- zū qā·nî·ṯā
verses.literal: and terror and dread will fall on them By the power of Your arm they will be as still as a stone until Your people pass by O LORD until the people You have bought pass by
verses.literalPt: Espanto e pavor caiu sobre eles; pela grandeza do teu braço emudeceram como pedra; até que o teu povo houvesse passado, ó SENHOR, até que passasse este povo que adquiriste.

verses.original: תְּבִאֵ֗מוֹ וְתִטָּעֵ֙מוֹ֙ בְּהַ֣ר נַחֲלָֽתְךָ֔ מָכ֧וֹן לְשִׁבְתְּךָ֛ פָּעַ֖לְתָּ יְהוָ֑ה מִקְּדָ֕שׁ אֲדֹנָ֖י כּוֹנְנ֥וּ יָדֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: tə·ḇi·’ê·mōw wə·ṯiṭ·ṭā·‘ê·mōw bə·har na·ḥă·lā·ṯə·ḵā mā·ḵō·wn lə·šiḇ·tə·ḵā pā·‘al·tā Yah·weh miq·qə·ḏāš ’ă·ḏō·nāy kō·wn·nū yā·ḏe·ḵā
verses.literal: You will bring them in and plant them on the mountain of Your inheritance the place O LORD You have prepared for Your dwelling the sanctuary O Lord Your hands have established
verses.literalPt: Tu os introduzirás, e os plantarás no monte da tua herança, no lugar que tu, ó SENHOR, aparelhaste para a tua habitação, no santuário, ó Senhor, que as tuas mãos estabeleceram.

verses.original: יְהוָ֥ה׀ יִמְלֹ֖ךְ לְעֹלָ֥ם וָעֶֽד׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh yim·lōḵ lə·‘ō·lām wā·‘eḏ
verses.literal: The LORD will reign forever and ever
verses.literalPt: O SENHOR reinará eterna e perpetuamente;

verses.original: כִּ֣י בָא֩ ס֨וּס פַּרְעֹ֜ה בְּרִכְבּ֤וֹ וּבְפָרָשָׁיו֙ בַּיָּ֔ם וַיָּ֧שֶׁב יְהוָ֛ה עֲלֵהֶ֖ם אֶת־ מֵ֣י הַיָּ֑ם וּבְנֵ֧י יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל הָלְכ֥וּ בַיַּבָּשָׁ֖ה בְּת֥וֹךְ הַיָּֽם׃פ
verses.transliteration: kî ḇā sūs par·‘ōh bə·riḵ·bōw ū·ḇə·p̄ā·rā·šāw bay·yām way·yā·šeḇ Yah·weh ‘ă·lê·hem ’eṯ- mê hay·yām ū·ḇə·nê yiś·rā·’êl hā·lə·ḵū ḇay·yab·bā·šāh bə·ṯō·wḵ hay·yām
verses.literal: For when Pharaoh’s horses chariots and horsemen went into the sea the LORD brought the waters of the sea back over them But the Israelites . . . walked through the sea on dry ground
verses.literalPt: Porque os cavalos de Faraó, com os seus carros e com os seus cavaleiros, entraram no mar, e o SENHOR fez tornar as águas do mar sobre eles; mas os filhos de Israel passaram em seco pelo meio do mar.

verses.original: וַתִּקַּח֩ מִרְיָ֨ם הַנְּבִיאָ֜ה אֲח֧וֹת אַהֲרֹ֛ן אֶת־ הַתֹּ֖ף בְּיָדָ֑הּ וַתֵּצֶ֤אןָ כָֽל־ הַנָּשִׁים֙ אַחֲרֶ֔יהָ בְּתֻפִּ֖ים וּבִמְחֹלֹֽת׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tiq·qaḥ mir·yām han·nə·ḇî·’āh ’ă·ḥō·wṯ ’a·hă·rōn ’eṯ- hat·tōp̄ bə·yā·ḏāh wat·tê·ṣe·nā ḵāl han·nā·šîm ’a·ḥă·re·hā bə·ṯup·pîm ū·ḇim·ḥō·lōṯ
verses.literal: Then Miriam the prophetess Aaron’s sister took a tambourine in her hand and all the women . . . followed her with tambourines and dancing
verses.literalPt: Então Miriã, a profetiza, a irmã de Arão, tomou o tamboril na sua mão, e todas as mulheres saíram atrás dela com tamboris e com danças.

verses.original: וַתַּ֥עַן לָהֶ֖ם מִרְיָ֑ם שִׁ֤ירוּ לַֽיהוָה֙ כִּֽי־ גָאֹ֣ה גָּאָ֔ה ס֥וּס וְרֹכְב֖וֹ רָמָ֥ה בַיָּֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: wat·ta·‘an lā·hem mir·yām šî·rū Yah·weh kî- ḡā·’ōh gā·’āh sūs wə·rō·ḵə·ḇōw rā·māh ḇay·yām
verses.literal: And Miriam sang back to them Sing to the LORD for He is highly exalted . . . the horse and rider He has thrown into the sea
verses.literalPt: E Miriã lhes respondia: Cantai ao SENHOR, porque gloriosamente triunfou; e lançou no mar o cavalo com o seu cavaleiro.

verses.original: וַיַּסַּ֨ע מֹשֶׁ֤ה אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ מִיַּם־ ס֔וּף וַיֵּצְא֖וּ אֶל־ מִדְבַּר־ שׁ֑וּר וַיֵּלְכ֧וּ שְׁלֹֽשֶׁת־ יָמִ֛ים בַּמִּדְבָּ֖ר וְלֹא־ מָ֥צְאוּ מָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yas·sa‘ mō·šeh ’eṯ- yiś·rā·’êl mî·yam- sūp̄ way·yê·ṣə·’ū ’el- miḏ·bar- šūr way·yê·lə·ḵū šə·lō·šeṯ- yā·mîm bam·miḏ·bār wə·lō- mā·ṣə·’ū mā·yim
verses.literal: Then Moses led Israel from the Red Sea and they went out into the Desert of Shur For three days they walked in the desert without finding water
verses.literalPt: Depois fez Moisés partir os israelitas do Mar Vermelho, e saíram ao deserto de Sur; e andaram três dias no deserto, e não acharam água.

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֣אוּ מָרָ֔תָה וְלֹ֣א יָֽכְל֗וּ לִשְׁתֹּ֥ת מַ֙יִם֙ מִמָּרָ֔ה כִּ֥י מָרִ֖ים הֵ֑ם עַל־ כֵּ֥ן קָרָֽא־ שְׁמָ֖הּ מָרָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō·’ū mā·rā·ṯāh wə·lō yā·ḵə·lū liš·tōṯ ma·yim mim·mā·rāh kî mā·rîm hêm ‘al- kên qā·rā- šə·māh mā·rāh
verses.literal: And when they came to Marah they could not drink the water there because it was bitter That is why . . . it was named . . . Marah
verses.literalPt: Então chegaram a Mara; mas não puderam beber das águas de Mara, porque eram amargas; por isso chamou-se o lugar Mara.

verses.original: וַיִּלֹּ֧נוּ הָעָ֛ם עַל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹ֖ר מַה־ נִּשְׁתֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yil·lō·nū hā·‘ām ‘al- mō·šeh lê·mōr mah- niš·teh
verses.literal: So the people grumbled against Moses saying What are we to drink
verses.literalPt: E o povo murmurou contra Moisés, dizendo: Que havemos de beber?

verses.original: וַיִּצְעַ֣ק אֶל־ יְהוָ֗ה וַיּוֹרֵ֤הוּ יְהוָה֙ עֵ֔ץ וַיַּשְׁלֵךְ֙ אֶל־ הַמַּ֔יִם וַֽיִּמְתְּק֖וּ הַמָּ֑יִם שָׁ֣ם שָׂ֥ם ל֛וֹ חֹ֥ק וּמִשְׁפָּ֖ט וְשָׁ֥ם נִסָּֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiṣ·‘aq ’el- Yah·weh way·yō·w·rê·hū Yah·weh ‘êṣ way·yaš·lêḵ ’el- ham·ma·yim way·yim·tə·qū ham·mā·yim šām śām lōw ḥōq ū·miš·pāṭ wə·šām nis·sā·hū
verses.literal: And Moses cried out to the LORD and the LORD showed him a log And when he cast it into the waters they were sweetened There the LORD made for them a statute and an ordinance and there He tested them
verses.literalPt: E ele clamou ao SENHOR, e o SENHOR mostrou-lhe uma árvore, que lançou nas águas, e as águas se tornaram doces. Ali lhes deu estatutos e uma ordenança, e ali os provou.

verses.original: וַיֹּאמֶר֩ אִם־ שָׁמ֨וֹעַ תִּשְׁמַ֜ע לְק֣וֹל׀ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֗יךָ וְהַיָּשָׁ֤ר בְּעֵינָיו֙ תַּעֲשֶׂ֔ה וְהַֽאֲזַנְתָּ֙ לְמִצְוֺתָ֔יו וְשָׁמַרְתָּ֖ כָּל־ חֻקָּ֑יו כָּֽל־ הַמַּֽחֲלָ֞ה אֲשֶׁר־ שַׂ֤מְתִּי בְמִצְרַ֙יִם֙ לֹא־ אָשִׂ֣ים עָלֶ֔יךָ כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה רֹפְאֶֽךָ׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’im- šā·mō·w·a‘ tiš·ma‘ lə·qō·wl Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā wə·hay·yā·šār bə·‘ê·nāw ta·‘ă·śeh wə·ha·’ă·zan·tā lə·miṣ·wō·ṯāw wə·šā·mar·tā kāl- ḥuq·qāw kāl- ham·ma·ḥă·lāh ’ă·šer- śam·tî ḇə·miṣ·ra·yim lō- ’ā·śîm ‘ā·le·ḵā kî ’ă·nî Yah·weh rō·p̄ə·’e·ḵā
verses.literal: saying If you will listen carefully . . . to the voice of the LORD your God and do what is right in His eyes and pay attention to His commands and keep all His statutes then I will not bring on you any of the diseases I inflicted on the Egyptians For I am the LORD who heals you
verses.literalPt: E disse: Se ouvires atento a voz do SENHOR teu Deus, e fizeres o que é reto diante de seus olhos, e inclinares os teus ouvidos aos seus mandamentos, e guardares todos os seus estatutos, nenhuma das enfermidades porei sobre ti, que pus sobre o Egito; porque eu sou o SENHOR que te sara.

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֣אוּ אֵילִ֔מָה וְשָׁ֗ם שְׁתֵּ֥ים עֶשְׂרֵ֛ה עֵינֹ֥ת מַ֖יִם וְשִׁבְעִ֣ים תְּמָרִ֑ים וַיַּחֲנוּ־ שָׁ֖ם עַל־ הַמָּֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō·’ū ’ê·li·māh wə·šām šə·têm ‘eś·rêh ‘ê·nōṯ ma·yim wə·šiḇ·‘îm tə·mā·rîm way·ya·ḥă·nū- šām ‘al- ham·mā·yim
verses.literal: Then they came to Elim where there were twelve . . . springs of water and seventy palm trees and they camped there by the waters
verses.literalPt: Então vieram a Elim, e havia ali doze fontes de água e setenta palmeiras; e ali se acamparam junto das águas.
